Hi Noor,

Sorry I missed your call. I was in back to back meetings all afternoon. I'm free tomorrow between 10 and 11 if that works for you, otherwise Friday morning is open.

Speak soon,
Will

optional.quote: if that works for you, otherwise

labels.notes: Ambiguous: "back-to-back" is the standard hyphenation before a noun, and "otherwise" after a comma is a mild splice. Both are left as review questions; the case is treated as clean (no required corrections). Reviewer should confirm.
